topics.problem: After a storm, assign repair crews to damaged feeder components as outage calls and field reports arrive, to minimize customer interruption time subject to radial precedence, travel times and the number of crews.
topics.hook: On a radial feeder, fixing a downstream line restores nobody until the upstream fault is cleared, which makes this scheduling with precedence. Tan et al. give a 2-approximation rule, a sharp baseline for a policy that must also cope with damage revealed over time.
topics.start: [Tan et al. 2017, scheduling post-disaster repairs in electricity distribution networks, arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.08382); [Amani, Ardali and Kargarian 2026, event-driven deep RL dispatcher for post-storm restoration on IEEE 13- and 123-bus feeders, arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10044); [Shuai and Li 2021, AlphaZero-based post-storm repair crew dispatch, arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.06764); [IEEE PES distribution test feeders](https://cmte.ieee.org/pes-testfeeders/resources/); model rebuilt from the paper
topics.baseline: Tan et al.'s ρ-factor dispatch rule, or their time-indexed ILP re-solved as information arrives
topics.angle: MCTS or actor-critic over the belief state of damage; amortize the re-solved ILP into a fast dispatch policy

topics.title: Post-earthquake water network repairs
topics.problem: After an earthquake, choose the order in which a few crews repair broken pipes, with damage drawn from fragility curves and only partly observed, to maximize the water demand served over the recovery period.
topics.hook: WNTR already models earthquake damage through fragility curves and pressure-dependent demand, so the repair-sequencing environment is a thin wrapper. Klise et al. stress that how bad an earthquake is for water service depends on available resources and repair strategy, not only on the shaking.
topics.start: [Klise et al. 2017, a software framework for assessing the resilience of drinking water systems to disasters with an example earthquake case study, Environ. Model. Softw.](https://www.sandia.gov/research/publications/details/a-software-framework-for-assessing-the-resilience-of-drinking-water-systems-2017-01-01/); [Fan, Zhang and Yu 2022, GCN-DRL model for resilient water distribution network repair decisions, CACAIE](https://researchconnect.buffalo.edu/en/publications/a-graph-convolution-network-deep-reinforcement-learning-model-for/); [WNTR simulator (EPA), pip install wntr](https://github.com/USEPA/WNTR); [WNTR disaster models: earthquake PGA, fragility curves, pipe leaks](https://usepa.github.io/WNTR/disaster_models.html)
topics.baseline: a fixed ranking of damaged pipes by component importance, the conventional rule
topics.angle: rollout or MCTS on WNTR with a learned value function, or a graph-network policy trained by RL; a learned hydraulic surrogate to make planning fast

topics.title: Critical load restoration with DERs
topics.problem: During a post-event outage with the feeder islanded, choose which critical loads to restore and how to dispatch local distributed energy resources over the coming hours under uncertain wind and solar forecasts, to maximize restored load within power-flow and energy limits.
topics.hook: NREL released the environment and the MPC baseline, so the project starts at the control question. Zhang et al. report that RL controllers were less sensitive to renewable forecast errors than the MPCs, a claim worth testing against a properly stochastic MPC.
topics.start: [Zhang et al. 2022, curriculum-based RL for distribution system critical load restoration, IEEE TPWRS (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.04166); [Zhang et al. 2021, curriculum-learned controller on the IEEE 13-bus system, IEEE PES GM](https://research-hub.nrel.gov/en/publications/restoring-critical-loads-in-resilient-distribution-systems-using--3/); [NREL hybrid-rl-mpc4clr: gym environment, MPC and RL code, BSD-3, archived 2026](https://github.com/NREL/hybrid-rl-mpc4clr)
topics.baseline: the repo's MPC driven by imperfect renewable forecasts
topics.angle: hybrid RL-MPC where RL sets the reserve the MPC must hold to hedge forecast error; compare with a scenario-based stochastic MPC

topics.title: Volt-VAR control
topics.problem: Volt-VAR control of an IEEE distribution feeder: capacitor switching, regulator taps and battery dispatch to hold voltages in band at minimum losses
topics.hook: Rooftop solar pushes voltages out of range on distribution feeders. Capacitors, tap changers and batteries keep them in band.
topics.start: [PowerGym, Fan et al. 2022, L4DC](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v168/fan22a.html); [Gao and Yu 2022, Volt-VAR logs for offline RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.09500); [PowerGym on OpenDSS](https://github.com/siemens/powergym)
topics.baseline: Local droop curves or OPF with the full model
topics.angle: offline RL from the logs, learned voltage-sensitivity model + mixed-integer MPC, or a policy amortized from OPF solutions

topics.title: Grid topology control
topics.problem: Grid topology control to relieve line congestion (L2RPN): substation reconfiguration and redispatch
topics.hook: Rewiring substations can relieve congested lines without building new ones. The action space is huge, and that is the challenge.
topics.start: [Marot et al. 2021, L2RPN retrospective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03104); [Grid2Op](https://grid2op.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
topics.baseline: Do-nothing and greedy one-step lookahead
topics.angle: tree search or MPC-style lookahead with the simulator as the model, offline RL from expert logs; keep to the 14-bus sandbox

topics.title: EV charging and vehicle-to-grid
topics.problem: EV fleet smart charging and vehicle-to-grid at a parking lot under transformer limits
topics.hook: Parked EVs can charge when power is cheap and even give some back. The simulator ships with a perfect-information MPC oracle to measure your gap.
topics.start: [EV2Gym, Orfanoudakis et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01849); [Diaz-Londono et al. 2024, MPC for V2G demand response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.11963); [ev2gym](https://pypi.org/project/ev2gym/)
topics.baseline: Charge-as-fast-as-possible and the perfect-information MPC oracle
topics.angle: policy amortized from MPC solutions, stochastic MPC with learned arrival and price models, offline RL

topics.title: Battery fast charging
topics.problem: Health-aware fast charging of a lithium-ion cell on an electrochemical model
topics.hook: Charging faster plates lithium and ages the cell. An electrochemical model lets you push right up to that limit.
topics.start: [Park et al. 2020, RL fast charging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02060); [Yuan and Zou 2025, lifelong RL for health-aware fast charging](https://web3.arxiv.org/abs/2505.11061); [PyBaMM](https://pybamm.org/)
topics.baseline: CC-CV protocol
topics.angle: NMPC on a reduced single-particle model with a learned residual, or a policy trained on SPMe and tested on DFN; plating potential as a hard constraint

topics.title: Wind-farm wake steering
topics.problem: Wind-farm wake steering: yaw offsets per turbine for farm-level power
topics.hook: Turning upstream turbines slightly off the wind steers their wakes away from the turbines behind. More energy from the same farm.
topics.start: [WFCRL, Bizon Monroc et al. 2024, NeurIPS D&B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.13592); [WindGym, JOSS 2026](https://www.theoj.org/joss-papers/joss.09946/10.21105.joss.09946.pdf); [wfcrl-env](https://github.com/ifpen/wfcrl-env), [FLORIS](https://github.com/NREL/floris)
topics.baseline: Greedy zero-yaw and the FLORIS static lookup table
topics.angle: learn a wake surrogate from FAST.Farm and run MPC on it, or train on FLORIS and test on FAST.Farm

topics.title: Grid frequency control
topics.problem: Primary frequency control with inverter-based resources, stability-constrained
topics.hook: Grids with fewer spinning generators need inverters that react within a fraction of a second. Stability guarantees meet learned controllers.
topics.start: [Cui et al. 2021, RL for primary frequency control, a Lyapunov approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.05654) with [code](https://github.com/Wenqi-Cui/RNN-RL-Frequency-Lyapunov); [ANDES](https://docs.andes.app/en/stable/)
topics.baseline: Optimized linear droop and LQR on the linearized swing model
topics.angle: structured monotone policy trained by backprop through the dynamics; compare with MPC

topics.title: Electrolyzer scheduling
topics.problem: PEM electrolyzer scheduling under variable renewable power with usage-based degradation: when to run, at what load, how much hydrogen to store
topics.hook: Green hydrogen is cheap only if electrolyzers run on cheap renewable power without wearing out. Degradation makes every start count.
topics.start: [Schofield et al. 2024, dynamic optimization of PEM electrolyzers with usage-based degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.06766)
topics.baseline: Open-loop MILP with perfect foresight
topics.angle: receding-horizon MPC with learned price and renewable forecasts and a learned degradation model, or a policy amortized from MILP solutions

topics.title: Water pump scheduling from logs
topics.problem: Pump scheduling in a real water distribution system from three years of facility logs
topics.hook: Pumping drinking water is a large electricity bill for a city. Three years of real logs from a German facility let you learn from what operators did.
topics.start: [Donâncio et al. 2022, the pump scheduling problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.11111) with [code and data](https://gitlab.com/hdonancio/pumpscheduling); [WNTR](https://usepa.github.io/WNTR/)
topics.baseline: Level-hysteresis rules and MILP with a demand forecast
topics.angle: offline RL from operator logs, learned demand model + MPC, exact DP over the tank level as a ceiling

topics.title: Lake Como reservoir
topics.problem: Multi-objective reservoir release on Lake Como daily records (1946 to 2010)
topics.hook: Lake Como's water serves farms and hydropower, and floods the town when it rises too far. Decades of daily records come ready to use.
topics.start: [Gym4ReaL, Salaorni et al. 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00257), [DamEnv](https://daveonwave.github.io/gym4ReaL/dam.html)
topics.baseline: Historical operator releases and stochastic DP
topics.angle: fitted value iteration vs MPC with ensemble inflow forecasts; Pareto front across objectives

topics.title: Wastewater aeration
topics.problem: Aeration (dissolved oxygen) control in an activated-sludge plant (BSM1/BSM2)
topics.hook: Aeration is the largest energy use in a wastewater plant. BSM1 is the benchmark the field itself uses.
topics.start: [Hernández-del-Olmo et al. 2016, Energies](https://www.mdpi.com/1996-1073/9/9/755); [bsm2-python](https://pypi.org/project/bsm2-python/)
topics.baseline: Default PI loops
topics.angle: learned reduced model + economic MPC, or RL on setpoints with PI underneath, scored with the standard cost and effluent-quality indices

topics.title: Irrigation canal regulation
topics.problem: Water-level regulation of an 11 km canal reach (Saint-Venant PDE)
topics.hook: Irrigation canals lose water when gates are badly operated. The dynamics are a hyperbolic PDE, so building a reduced model is the main event.
topics.start: [Wang and Qi 2026, backstepping-guided RL for canal regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20089)
topics.baseline: PI on the downstream level and the backstepping law
topics.angle: reduced-order (POD or Koopman) model + MPC; robustness to large deviations; the solver is yours to write

topics.title: Chlorine dosing in water networks
topics.problem: Chlorine booster dosing in a water network
topics.hook: Too little chlorine and the water is unsafe; too much and it forms by-products. Transport delays through the pipes make it a lagged control problem.
topics.start: [Monsia et al. 2026, surrogate-assisted chlorination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07299); [WNTR](https://usepa.github.io/WNTR/)
topics.baseline: Constant or scheduled dosing
topics.angle: learned transport surrogate from EPANET runs, MPC with constraint tightening; transport delays make credit assignment interesting

topics.title: Process units with an NMPC oracle
topics.problem: PC-Gym process units (crystallizer, four-tank, biofilm reactor) against an NMPC oracle
topics.hook: A tidy set of process units with an NMPC oracle, so you always know how far your learned controller is from optimal.
topics.start: [PC-Gym, Bloor et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.22093); [pc-gym](https://github.com/MaximilianB2/pc-gym)
topics.baseline: PID and the built-in NMPC oracle
topics.angle: learned Koopman or NN model + MPC, policy distilled from NMPC, RL under mismatch; report the optimality gap to the oracle

topics.title: Decision-focused models for a chemical plant
topics.problem: Economic NMPC for demand response of a chemical process under electricity prices
topics.hook: Train the model for the decision, not for prediction accuracy. A chemical plant that follows electricity prices makes the question concrete.
topics.start: [Mayfrank et al. 2024, end-to-end RL of Koopman models for eNMPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.01674); [air-separation follow-up, 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04522)
topics.baseline: eNMPC with the mechanistic model and a system-identified Koopman model
topics.angle: decision-focused training of the Koopman model through the MPC

topics.title: Penicillin fermentation
topics.problem: Fed-batch penicillin fermentation: feed and environment control
topics.hook: Fed-batch fermentation makes antibiotics and many other products. Batch datasets let you try offline RL against an MPC baseline.
topics.start: [SMPL, Zhang et al. 2022, NeurIPS D&B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.08851); [Petsagkourakis et al. 2019, RL for batch bioprocess optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.07292); [smpl](https://github.com/smpl-env/smpl)
topics.baseline: Fixed recipe and the included MPC
topics.angle: offline RL from the batch datasets, batch-to-batch policy gradient, GP or NN dynamics + MPC with a terminal reward

topics.title: Tennessee Eastman plant
topics.problem: Tennessee Eastman plant-wide control with a residual policy
topics.hook: The classic plant-wide control problem of process engineering: 41 measurements, 12 valves and 20 standard disturbances.
topics.start: [Abbas et al. 2023, residual safe RL on the TE process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.14788); [simplified TEP environment](https://github.com/AIRI-Institute/iprl_benchmark) (MATLAB-free)
topics.baseline: Decentralized PID structure
topics.angle: residual policy on top of PID, or learned Koopman model + MPC on a subset of loops under the standard disturbances

topics.title: Anaerobic digester
topics.problem: Anaerobic digester (ADM1) biogas production under feedstock uncertainty
topics.hook: Digesters turn food waste and sludge into biogas. Overfeed them and the microbes acidify and stop; the constraint is real.
topics.start: [Gao et al. 2024, Communications Engineering](https://link.springer.com/10.1038/s44172-024-00183-7); [PyADM1](https://github.com/CaptainFerMag/PyADM1)
topics.baseline: PID on gas flow and constant loading rate
topics.angle: learned two-time-scale dynamics + MPC, robust policy with randomized influent, acidification as a hard constraint

topics.title: Microalgae photobioreactor
topics.problem: Microalgae raceway photobioreactor: pH, dissolved oxygen, harvest and economics
topics.hook: Microalgae grow on CO2 and sunlight. The cited group deployed behaviour cloning on an industrial reactor, so the path to the real thing is short.
topics.start: [Otálora et al. 2025, economic MPC for industrial microalgae](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15668); [Gil et al. 2025, behaviour cloning deployed on an industrial photobioreactor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.06853)
topics.baseline: Fixed harvest and on/off CO2 with PI on pH
topics.angle: behaviour cloning from PID then online fine-tuning, or EMPC with a learned growth model; the model is rebuilt from the paper

topics.title: Lettuce greenhouse climate
topics.problem: Lettuce greenhouse climate: RL-tuned MPC vs MPC vs RL on the van Henten model
topics.hook: Greenhouses burn gas for heat and CO2. Tuning an MPC with RL on the standard lettuce model is a well-scoped first project.
topics.start: [Mallick et al. 2024, RL-based MPC for greenhouse climate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.12789) with [code](https://github.com/SamuelMallick/mpcrl-greenhouse); [Morcego et al. 2023, RL vs MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.06110)
topics.baseline: Nominal MPC with the true model and grower setpoint schedules
topics.angle: RL tuning of the MPC cost, backoff or model under mismatch, or a learned terminal cost for short-horizon MPC

topics.title: Tomato greenhouse (GreenLight)
topics.problem: Tomato production control on the GreenLight model
topics.hook: GreenLight is the reference model for high-tech greenhouses. Short-horizon MPC with a learned terminal value is this course's spine in one project.
topics.start: [GreenLight-Gym, van Laatum et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05336); [van Laatum et al. 2026, RL inside short-horizon MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07365); [GreenLightGym](https://github.com/BartvLaatum/GreenLightGym)
topics.baseline: Rule-based grower controller
topics.angle: short-horizon NMPC with an RL-learned terminal value vs PPO under parametric uncertainty

topics.title: Nitrogen fertilization
topics.problem: Nitrogen fertilization timing and dose for wheat
topics.hook: Making and spreading nitrogen fertilizer emits a lot, and what the crop does not take up pollutes water. The right dose at the right time cuts both.
topics.start: [CropGym, Overweg et al. 2021](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.04326); [WOFOSTGym, Solow et al. 2025, RLC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19308); [WOFOSTGym](https://github.com/Intelligent-Reliable-Autonomous-Systems/WOFOSTGym)
topics.baseline: Agronomic split-application rule and an open-loop optimized schedule
topics.angle: offline RL and off-policy evaluation from logged seasons, forecast-aware policy vs DP over discretized soil nitrogen

topics.title: Irrigation scheduling
topics.problem: Irrigation scheduling for maize or wheat with soil-water dynamics
topics.hook: Agriculture uses most of the world's freshwater. Measuring the value of a weather forecast in litres saved makes a good poster.
topics.start: [Saikai et al. 2023, deep RL for irrigation scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.00899); [gym-DSSAT, Gautron et al. 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.03270); [AquaCrop-OSPy](https://aquacropos.github.io/aquacrop/)
topics.baseline: Soil-moisture threshold rule
topics.angle: MPC with weather-ensemble forecasts on the AquaCrop model vs the rule vs an RL policy; quantify the value of forecast information

topics.title: Indoor-farm lighting
topics.problem: Indoor-farm LED lighting with time-of-use prices and a thermal model
topics.hook: Vertical farms trade sunlight for electricity. Lighting when power is cheap while hitting the plants' daily light dose is the whole business.
topics.start: [LightFARM, Yu et al. 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.27649)
topics.baseline: Fixed photoperiod
topics.angle: learned light-response model + MPC, or DP over the daily light budget with prices; the model is rebuilt from the paper

topics.title: Traffic signals with speed advice
topics.problem: Traffic-signal control with speed advice on calibrated city corridors (RESCO scenarios in SUMO)
topics.hook: Idling at red lights burns fuel and time. Calibrated scenarios from Cologne and Ingolstadt keep it real.
topics.start: [RESCO, Ault and Sharon 2021, NeurIPS D&B](https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/f0935e4cd5920aa6c7c996a5ee53a70f-Abstract-round1.html); [Busch et al. 2023, joint signal and speed advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.09881); [sumo-rl](https://github.com/lucasalegre/sumo-rl), [CityFlow](https://github.com/cityflow-project/CityFlow)
topics.baseline: Fixed-time (Webster) and max-pressure
topics.angle: learn a store-and-forward queue model from rollouts, MPC over phases, amortize into a policy; compare with the published DQN numbers

topics.title: Highway ramp metering
topics.problem: Highway ramp metering with MPC as the policy class (METANET model)
topics.hook: MPC as the policy class, tuned by RL. The paper's code is public, so your contribution is a new network, a learned model or real demand data.
topics.start: [Airaldi et al. 2023, RL with MPC for ramp metering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.08820) with [code](https://github.com/FilippoAiraldi/mpcrl-for-ramp-metering); [sym-metanet](https://github.com/FilippoAiraldi/sym-metanet)
topics.baseline: PI-ALINEA
topics.angle: MPC with a deliberately wrong model whose parameters are tuned by Q-learning, or learned residual dynamics, vs black-box DDPG; change the network or use logged demand so it is not a rerun

topics.title: Workplace EV charging
topics.problem: Workplace EV charging on the Caltech ACN data
topics.hook: Real charging sessions from Caltech and JPL garages, with real three-phase limits. Forecast when drivers leave and you can charge more cars on the same wires.
topics.start: [Lee et al. 2019, ACN-Data, e-Energy](https://authors.library.caltech.edu/records/yvh76-f6d35); [ACN-Sim, Lee et al. 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.02809); [acnportal](https://github.com/zach401/acnportal)
topics.baseline: Round-robin and least-laxity-first
topics.angle: MPC with learned arrival and departure forecasts fitted on the data, or offline RL from historical sessions, with the three-phase constraints checked

topics.title: Eco-driving at intersections
topics.problem: Eco-driving of a connected EV through signalized intersections
topics.hook: Knowing when the light turns green lets a car glide instead of braking. Longitudinal MPC with a learned model of the car ahead.
topics.start: [Jiang et al. 2022, eco-driving at signalized intersections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12065); SUMO electric-vehicle model
topics.baseline: Car-following plus a green-wave heuristic
topics.angle: MPC on longitudinal dynamics with a learned leader predictor, then distill into a policy

topics.title: Airport departure metering
topics.problem: Airport departure metering (pushback rate control) with a learned runway-queue model
topics.hook: Planes queueing for takeoff with engines running burn fuel for nothing. Holding them at the gate a little longer cuts that without losing throughput.
topics.start: [Simaiakis and Balakrishnan 2016, Transportation Science](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/105359); [Sandberg et al. 2014, pushback rate control](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/96873); [BTS on-time performance data](https://www.transtats.bts.gov/DL_SelectFields.aspx?gnoyr_VQ=FGJ&QO_fu146_anzr=b0-gvzr)
topics.baseline: Fixed pushback rate
topics.angle: fit the transient queue model to one airport's taxi-out data, MPC on the pushback rate, offline RL on logged days; the surface simulator is yours to build

topics.title: Spacecraft docking
topics.problem: Spacecraft docking and inspection with run-time assurance (Clohessy-Wiltshire dynamics)
topics.hook: Approaching a station comes with hard safety cones. Run-time assurance lets a learned controller fly inside them.
topics.start: [Dunlap et al. 2021, run-time assurance for docking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.00447); [Dunlap et al. 2024, six-degree-of-freedom inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.11795); [safe-autonomy-sims](https://github.com/act3-ace/safe-autonomy-sims)
topics.baseline: LQR or MPC on the CW model
topics.angle: RL with a control-barrier filter vs MPC with learned residual dynamics (drag, J2)

topics.title: Satellite attitude control
topics.problem: Satellite attitude control with a physics-informed learned model inside MPC, including a reaction-wheel failure
topics.hook: Losing a reaction wheel should not end a mission. A physics-informed model inside MPC against a learned policy, under actuator failure.
topics.start: [Cena et al. 2026, hybrid MPC with a physics-informed network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15954); [El Hariry et al. 2025, underactuated attitude control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.00165); [Basilisk](https://hanspeterschaub.info/basilisk/)
topics.baseline: Quaternion PD or LQR
topics.angle: residual system identification (PINN or SINDy) + NMPC vs PPO under actuator failure

topics.title: Earth-observation satellite tasking
topics.problem: Earth-observing satellite tasking under power and storage constraints
topics.hook: Earth-observing satellites watch forests, ice and crops. Choosing what to image with limited battery and storage is a planning problem.
topics.start: [BSK-RL, Stephenson and Schaub 2024](https://hanspeterschaub.info/Papers/Stephenson2024c.pdf); [bsk-rl](https://avslab.github.io/bsk_rl/)
topics.baseline: Greedy scheduler
topics.angle: receding-horizon DP or tree search with a learned resource model, then an amortized policy

topics.title: Contrail-aware flight paths
topics.problem: Contrail-aware 4D flight trajectory optimization under forecast uncertainty
topics.hook: Contrails may warm the planet about as much as aviation's CO2, and a small change of altitude avoids many of them. The open toolchain already runs collocation with real winds.
topics.start: [Sun and Olive 2025, feasibility of climate-optimal routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.13907); [OpenAP.top, Sun 2022, Aerospace](https://www.mdpi.com/2226-4310/9/7/383); [openap-top](https://github.com/junzis/openap-top) (CasADi collocation, ERA5 winds)
topics.baseline: Deterministic fuel-optimal collocation
topics.angle: scenario or robust MPC with re-planning as forecasts update, or a policy amortized from many optimized trajectories

topics.title: Air traffic conflict resolution
topics.problem: En-route conflict resolution and arrival merging in BlueSky
topics.hook: Aircraft must stay 5 nautical miles apart, and more direct routes save fuel. Bring a model-based angle, not just another RL agent.
topics.start: [BlueSky-Gym, Groot et al. 2024](https://research.tudelft.nl/en/publications/bluesky-gym-reinforcement-learning-environments-for-air-traffic-a/); [bluesky-gym](https://github.com/TUDelft-CNS-ATM/bluesky-gym)
topics.baseline: Geometric and rule-based resolution
topics.angle: MPC with a learned intruder-intent predictor vs SAC or PPO; scaling with traffic density; the model-based angle is required here

topics.title: Delivery-drone energy
topics.problem: Energy-aware delivery-drone speed and altitude in wind, from real flight data
topics.hook: 196 real delivery flights with power, wind and payload. Fit how much energy each speed costs, then plan the speed profile.
topics.start: [Rodrigues et al. 2021, DJI Matrice 100 delivery dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.13313); [Muli et al. 2022, drone energy models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.01609); [CMU dataset](https://kilthub.cmu.edu/articles/dataset/Data_Collected_with_Package_Delivery_Quadcopter_Drone/12683453)
topics.baseline: Constant cruise speed
topics.angle: fit power as a function of speed, payload and wind, then DP or MPC over the speed profile with scenario wind; validate on held-out flights

topics.title: Satellite collision avoidance
topics.problem: When to maneuver: collision-avoidance decisions from conjunction data messages
topics.hook: Low orbit is getting crowded. Whether and when to manoeuvre, from a stream of conjunction warnings, is optimal stopping on real ESA data.
topics.start: [Bourriez et al. 2023, autonomous collision avoidance with RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.18966); [Uriot et al. 2020, ESA collision avoidance challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.03069); [Kelvins CDM dataset](https://kelvins.esa.int/collision-avoidance-challenge/data/)
topics.baseline: Threshold rule on collision probability
topics.angle: learn a risk-evolution model from CDM sequences, then optimal stopping by DP or a POMDP; offline RL from historical events

topics.title: Wafer-fab dispatching
topics.problem: Lot dispatching in a wafer fab (SMT2020 in PySCFabSim)
topics.hook: Chip fabs route lots through hundreds of tools with setups and queue-time limits. Dispatching rules still dominate, so there is room to do better.
topics.start: [Tassel et al. 2023, fab scheduling with self-supervised and RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.07162); [Stöckermann et al. 2025, scalability of RL dispatching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11135); [PySCFabSim](https://github.com/prosysscience/PySCFabSim-release)
topics.baseline: FIFO, critical ratio, earliest due date
topics.angle: fluid or queueing model + rolling-horizon dispatch vs policy gradient; restrict to one bottleneck area (lithography)

topics.title: Warehouse robot dispatch
topics.problem: Robot-to-task dispatch in a warehouse as a queueing control problem
topics.hook: A fleet of warehouse robots is a queueing network. Add realistic orders and congestion, or it stays a toy.
topics.start: [Krnjaic et al. 2024, scalable MARL for warehouse logistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.11498); [RWARE](https://github.com/semitable/robotic-warehouse)
topics.baseline: Nearest-idle-robot and FIFO
topics.angle: aggregate fluid model of aisle queues + MPC-based assignment vs hierarchical MARL; add realistic order statistics and congestion, or it stays a toy

topics.title: Metal 3D printing melt pool
topics.problem: Layer-to-layer melt-pool control in laser powder bed fusion
topics.hook: Metal 3D printing fails when the melt pool runs too hot or too cold. Learning control across layers is iterative learning control in action.
topics.start: [Liao-McPherson et al. 2024, layer-to-layer melt pool control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10218); [Ogoke and Barati Farimani 2021, thermal control with deep RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.03355); [AdditiveFOAM](https://github.com/ORNL/AdditiveFOAM) for validation
topics.baseline: Constant power or PI on the melt pool
topics.angle: learn a layer-to-layer linear or Koopman model from a few simulated layers, then iterative-learning control or MPC

topics.title: Mineral grinding circuit
topics.problem: Grinding-mill circuit control (run-of-mine ore)
topics.hook: Grinding ore takes a large share of a mine's energy. Ore hardness changes all the time, and the published model gives you every parameter.
topics.start: [Le Roux et al. 2013, grinding mill circuit model, Minerals Engineering](https://repository.up.ac.za/handle/2263/39683); [Van Niekerk et al. 2025, RL-tuned PID for grinding circuits, Control Engineering Practice](https://repository.up.ac.za/items/9ac56fb7-85b2-4949-9427-f172fa652e45)
topics.baseline: Decentralized PID
topics.angle: NMPC on the true model vs MPC on an identified model (SINDy or NN), RL-tuned PID; robustness to ore-hardness changes; the published ODE model is implemented by you

topics.title: Kraft pulp digester
topics.problem: Kappa-number control of a continuous kraft digester
topics.hook: Pulp mills cook wood chips for hours in a tall column. Long transport delays and grade changes make it a slow, hard MPC problem.
topics.start: [Rantanen et al. 2005, blow-line kappa number, IFAC](https://folk.ntnu.no/skoge/prost/proceedings/ifac2005/Fullpapers/03850.pdf); [kraft digester model code, University of Pretoria](https://researchdata.up.ac.za/articles/code/Kraft_digester_modelling_and_optimization_code/22302685)
topics.baseline: H-factor and PI temperature control
topics.angle: Koopman or NN surrogate of the distributed model + MPC with long transport delays and grade transitions

topics.title: Tokamak ramp-up
topics.problem: Tokamak ramp-up control in Gym-TORAX (ITER hybrid scenario)
topics.hook: A fusion plasma must be shaped carefully as its current ramps up. TORAX is differentiable, so you can optimize trajectories through the simulator itself.
topics.start: [Gym-TORAX, Mouchamps et al. 2025](https://arxiv.org/html/2510.11283v1); [TORAX, Citrin et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.06718); [gymtorax](https://github.com/antoine-mouchamps/gymtorax)
topics.baseline: Open-loop reference and PI
topics.angle: gradient-based trajectory optimization through the differentiable JAX simulator, MPC with a reduced model, then amortize

topics.title: Tokamak ramp-down
topics.problem: Robust tokamak ramp-down trajectory design with a learned plasma model
topics.hook: Disruptions during ramp-down can damage a reactor. Learn a plasma model, then design ramp-downs that stay safe under uncertainty.
topics.start: [Wang et al. 2024, ramp-downs with neural differential equations and RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09387); [Wang et al. 2025, predict-first experiments at TCV](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.12327); [DisruptionPy](https://github.com/MIT-PSFC/disruption-py) for open MAST data
topics.baseline: Hand-designed feed-forward ramp
topics.angle: neural state-space fit, constrained trajectory optimization under sampled parameters (robust MPC) vs constraint-conditioned RL

topics.title: Particle accelerator tuning
topics.problem: Transverse beam tuning in a linac section with a differentiable accelerator simulator
topics.hook: Physicists spend hours tuning magnets by hand. A differentiable accelerator simulator makes model-based tuning possible.
topics.start: [Kaiser et al. 2022, ICML](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v162/kaiser22a.html); [Kaiser et al. 2023, RL vs Bayesian optimisation for online tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.03739); [Cheetah](https://github.com/desy-ml/cheetah), [rl-vs-bo](https://github.com/desy-ml/rl-vs-bo)
topics.baseline: Nelder-Mead and Bayesian optimisation
topics.angle: MPC through the differentiable model with online estimation of misalignments vs an RL-trained optimizer; add the partial-observability angle

topics.title: Fermilab Booster regulation
topics.problem: Gradient-magnet power-supply regulation at the Fermilab Booster from logged data
topics.hook: One day of real control data from a Fermilab accelerator, and no simulator. Honest offline evaluation is the whole project.
topics.start: [St. John et al. 2021, real-time AI for accelerator control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.07371); [BOOSTR dataset, Kafkes and St. John 2021](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.08359), [data on Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/record/4088982)
topics.baseline: The existing regulator visible in the logs
topics.angle: learned dynamics + MPC, or offline RL with off-policy evaluation; purely offline, so evaluation honesty is the project

topics.title: Adaptive optics for exoplanets
topics.problem: Predictive adaptive-optics control for exoplanet imaging
topics.hook: Imaging planets around other stars needs mirrors that reshape about a thousand times a second to cancel the atmosphere. Predicting beats reacting.
topics.start: [Nousiainen et al. 2022, towards on-sky AO control with RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.07554); [Nousiainen et al. 2023, laboratory experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00242); [OOPAO](https://github.com/cheritier/OOPAO)
topics.baseline: Integrator with a static reconstructor
topics.angle: learned temporal dynamics of the modes, predictive MPC or LQG; test under wind-speed changes

topics.title: Cryogenic helium plant
topics.problem: Helium cryogenic refrigerator under pulsed heat loads
topics.hook: Superconducting magnets need helium at 4.5 K or colder. Pulsed heat loads from the machine test the refrigerator's controller.
topics.start: [Alamir et al. 2017, hierarchical MPC for a cryogenic refrigerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.08813); [Noga and de Prada 2008, LHC superfluid helium circuit model](https://www.msc-les.org/proceedings/emss/2008/EMSS2008_806.pdf)
topics.baseline: PID loops
topics.angle: learned residual model + hierarchical MPC with forecasting of pulsed loads; no open simulator, so modelling is most of the work

topics.title: Depth of anesthesia
topics.problem: Depth-of-anesthesia control: propofol and remifentanil infusion rates to hold BIS in 40 to 60 and blood pressure in range, under surgical stimulation and patient variability
topics.hook: Anesthesiologists titrate drugs while watching a brain-activity index. Closed-loop control on a pharmacological model, tested on many virtual patients.
topics.start: [Schamberg et al. 2020, titrating propofol with deep RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.12333); [Python Anesthesia Simulator](https://github.com/AnesthesiaSimulation/Python_Anesthesia_Simulator) ([JOSS 2023](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.05480))
topics.baseline: PID or target-controlled infusion
topics.angle: nonlinear MPC on the PK/PD model with online patient-parameter estimation, then amortize into a policy; evaluate across sampled virtual patients

topics.title: Mechanical ventilation
topics.problem: Pressure-controlled mechanical ventilation: valve opening every 30 ms to track a pressure waveform across lungs with unknown resistance and compliance
topics.hook: A ventilator must deliver the right pressure to lungs it has never seen. Learn the lung from recorded breaths, then control through that model.
topics.start: [Suo et al. 2021, machine learning for mechanical ventilation control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.06779); lung simulator in [deluca](https://github.com/google/deluca); [Kaggle ventilator dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/ventilator-pressure-prediction)
topics.baseline: PID per lung
topics.angle: identify a lung model from recorded breaths, then MPC or iLQR through it; test on unseen lungs

topics.title: Sepsis treatment from ICU logs
topics.problem: Sepsis fluids and vasopressors from ICU logs (offline RL)
topics.hook: Sepsis is a leading cause of death in hospitals. Learning a treatment policy from logs alone is offline RL at its purest, and its riskiest.
topics.start: [Komorowski et al. 2018, The AI Clinician, Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-018-0213-5); [Tang and Wiens 2021, model selection for offline RL in healthcare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.11003); [MIMIC-IV](https://physionet.org/content/mimiciv/) (credentialing takes 1 to 3 weeks); small [sepsis simulator](https://github.com/clinicalml/gumbel-max-scm) for sanity checks
topics.baseline: Clinician policy and a fixed protocol
topics.angle: fitted Q iteration or conservative offline RL with off-policy evaluation validated on the simulator first

topics.title: Adaptive radiotherapy
topics.problem: Adaptive radiotherapy fractionation: today's dose given observed tumour and organ positions and repopulation
topics.hook: Radiation is delivered over many sessions while the tumour moves. Exact DP gives the ground truth to measure a learned policy against.
topics.start: [Ramakrishnan et al. 2011, a DP approach to adaptive fractionation](https://arxiv.org/abs/1109.4524); [Bortfeld et al. 2015, fractionation with tumour repopulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/1312.1332)
topics.baseline: Uniform fractionation
topics.angle: exact DP as ground truth, then a learned policy with model parameters estimated online

topics.title: HIV treatment interruption
topics.problem: HIV structured treatment interruption from batch clinical data
topics.hook: A classic of batch RL: fitted Q iteration on clinical-style data, against a model-based alternative.
topics.start: [Ernst et al. 2006, clinical-data-based STI strategies, CDC](https://orbi.uliege.be/handle/2268/13367); ODE in [rlpy HIVTreatment](https://github.com/rlpy/rlpy/blob/master/rlpy/Domains/HIVTreatment.py)
topics.baseline: Fixed schedules
topics.angle: fitted Q iteration from batch data vs learned ODE + MPC

topics.title: Warfarin dosing
topics.problem: Warfarin dose titration to an INR target
topics.hook: Warfarin is a common blood thinner with a narrow safe range. Dosing with delayed lab results is a partially observed control problem.
topics.start: [Anzabi Zadeh et al. 2022, warfarin dosing with deep RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.03486v2); [hemosim](https://pypi.org/project/hemosim/) environments
topics.baseline: Clinical nomograms
topics.angle: PK/PD model with Bayesian parameter estimation and MPC, including the delayed-measurement variant

topics.title: Deep brain stimulation
topics.problem: Closed-loop deep brain stimulation: desynchronize a neural population with minimal stimulation energy
topics.hook: Closed-loop stimulation could treat Parkinson's symptoms with less energy and fewer side effects. A model neural population is the testbed.
topics.start: [Krylov et al. 2020, RL framework for DBS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.10948); [RL-DBS environment](https://github.com/cviaai/RL-DBS)
topics.baseline: Open-loop high-frequency stimulation and delayed feedback
topics.angle: reduced phase or Koopman model + MPC

topics.title: Ambulance redeployment with ADP
topics.problem: Each time an ambulance becomes free, decide which base to send it to (and optionally move other idle units), under random call arrival times, locations and service durations, to maximize the fraction of calls reached within the response-time target with a fixed fleet and set of bases.
topics.hook: The move-up decision recurs after every call and directly sets how many calls are reached in time. JEMSS ships a Manhattan model you can calibrate with NYC's public dispatch file, which logs call creation, assignment, on-scene and hospital arrival times per incident by dispatch area.
topics.start: [Maxwell, Restrepo, Henderson & Topaloglu 2010, ADP for ambulance redeployment, INFORMS J. Computing](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/fpi/10.1287/ijoc.1090.0345); [JEMSS.jl EMS simulator with Auckland, Edmonton, Manhattan and Utrecht models](https://github.com/uoa-ems-research/JEMSS.jl); [NYC EMS incident dispatch data](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Public-Safety/EMS-Incident-Dispatch-Data/76xm-jjuj); [Guigues et al. 2024, EMS management tools with Rio de Janeiro SAMU call history](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.09154) and [their dispatch/relocation heuristics code](https://github.com/vguigues/Heuristics_Dynamic_Ambulance_Management)
topics.baseline: static policy that returns each ambulance to its home base (the paper's static benchmarks)
topics.angle: value-function ADP over the ambulance configuration with basis functions tuned by simulation; compare to PPO or a short-horizon MPC lookahead in the simulator

topics.title: Hospital platelet ordering
topics.problem: Each day, decide how many platelet units to order given stock by remaining shelf life and orders in transit, under uncertain daily demand, to minimize expected outdating, shortage and holding cost with delivery lead times and a shelf life of a few days.
topics.hook: Platelets keep only three to seven days, so hospitals both discard units and run short. At RWTH Aachen University Hospital historical outdating was about 10.1% and shortage about 6.5%, and forecast-driven ordering roughly halved both in retrospective simulation; viso_jax lets you check any learned policy against the exact optimum.
topics.start: [Farrington, Li, Wong & Utley 2023, GPU value iteration for perishable inventory (arXiv)](https://www.arxiv.org/abs/2303.10672); [viso_jax code, Scenario C = hospital platelets after Mirjalili 2022](https://github.com/joefarrington/viso_jax); [Schilling et al. 2022, forecast-driven platelet ordering at RWTH Aachen, JMIR Med. Inform.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8848235)
topics.baseline: order-up-to policy fitted by simulation optimization, with exact value iteration as the reference optimum
topics.angle: decision-focused training of the demand forecaster on ordering cost instead of MAPE; amortize the value-iteration policy or train PPO and measure the gap to the exact optimum

topics.title: Dynamic kidney exchange: match or wait
topics.problem: At each match run, choose which cycles and chains of incompatible patient-donor pairs and altruistic donors to execute now versus keep in the pool, under random arrivals, departures and failed matches, to maximize (quality-weighted) transplants over the horizon subject to cycle and chain length caps.
topics.hook: Executing every cycle available today can consume pairs that would have formed better cycles after the next arrivals, while waiting risks patients leaving the pool. kep_solver includes a dynamic simulator and a published UK NHS 2022 generator, so the trade-off can be tested end to end with an exact IP inside the loop.
topics.start: [Dickerson & Sandholm 2015, FutureMatch: learning to match in dynamic kidney exchange, AAAI](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/9239); [Barkel et al. 2025, survey and empirical evaluation of kidney exchange models with open instances](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04091); [kep_solver API: DynamicGenerator, DynamicSimulation, uk_nhs_generator2022](https://kep-solver.readthedocs.io/en/latest/source/kep_solver.html); [kep_solver on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/kep-solver/)
topics.baseline: myopic maximum-transplant matching at every run
topics.angle: learn vertex/pair potentials (a value function) that reweight the matching IP, tuned by policy gradient in the dynamic simulator; optionally learn when to run a match

topics.title: Inpatient overflow to off-service wards
topics.problem: Throughout the day, decide which waiting inpatients to place in a nonprimary (overflow) ward instead of waiting for a bed in their primary ward, under time-varying random admissions and discharges, to minimize long-run average waiting cost plus overflow penalties with fixed ward capacities.
topics.hook: Bed managers make this call every hour. In the paper's baseline scenario the ADP policy matched complete bed sharing on congestion with 20% less overflow, and the PPO follow-up scaled to 20 wards with about 25% lower cost than night-time-only practice.
topics.start: [Dai & Shi 2019, Inpatient overflow: an ADP approach, MSOM](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/suppl/10.1287/msom.2018.0730); [Sun, Shi & Dai 2024, Inpatient overflow management with PPO (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/html/2410.13767v4); model rebuilt from the paper
topics.baseline: night-time-only overflow (current practice), complete overflow, and the Dai and Shi ADP policy
topics.angle: basis-function ADP from a fluid/single-pool approximation versus PPO on the multiclass multipool queue

topics.title: Tuning deceased-donor allocation rules
topics.problem: Choose the parameters of the deceased-donor kidney allocation rule (point weights on HLA match, waiting time, vPRA, donor-candidate age matching) that rank candidates for each donor, under random donor and candidate arrivals, offer acceptance and waitlist removal, to improve transplant outcomes and equity across groups and countries within Eurotransplant's balance rules.
topics.hook: Eurotransplant allocates organs across eight countries, and these simulators were built with its physicians and advisory committees to evaluate rule changes; ETKidney reproduces the current kidney rules, was validated on 2021 to 2024 outcomes, and exposes point weights in YAML. The shipped synthetic data is for trying the code only; research-grade conclusions need a study proposal to Eurotransplant.
topics.start: [de Ferrante et al. 2025, ETKidney discrete event simulator for Eurotransplant (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/html/2502.15001v1); [ETKidney code with synthetic data](https://github.com/hansdeferrante/Eurotransplant_ETKidney_simulator); [de Ferrante et al., ELAS liver allocation simulator (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10840); [ELAS code with synthetic data](http://github.com/hansdeferrante/Eurotransplant_ELAS_simulator)
topics.baseline: Eurotransplant's current ETKAS/ESP point system
topics.angle: black-box policy optimization (policy gradient or evolution strategies) over point weights, with a learned surrogate of simulator outcomes to cut simulation cost

topics.title: Week-by-week nurse rostering
topics.problem: Each week, assign shifts and skills to nurses knowing only that week's coverage requirements and requests while later weeks are unknown, to minimize the weighted soft-constraint penalty over a 4- or 8-week horizon subject to hard single-assignment, minimum-coverage, shift-succession and skill constraints.
topics.hook: A weekly solver has to decide how much of each nurse's total-shift and weekend quota to spend before seeing next week's demand, which is a value-function question. INRC-II gives 14 datasets (30 to 120 nurses, 4 or 8 weeks) with a stage-by-stage simulator and a validator.
topics.start: [Ceschia, Dang, De Causmaecker, Haspeslagh & Schaerf 2015, INRC-II problem description (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1501.04177); [INRC-II datasets](https://mobiz.vives.be/inrc2/?page_id=20); [INRC-II simulator, validator and benchmark tools](https://mobiz.vives.be/inrc2/?page_id=245); [Kim & Mehrotra 2015, two-stage stochastic nurse staffing on Northwestern Memorial data, Operations Research](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/fpi/10.1287/opre.2015.1421)
topics.baseline: myopic weekly optimization that ignores future weeks
topics.angle: learn a value function of the end-of-week history (work and weekend counters, last shifts) and add it as a terminal cost to the weekly MIP or local search

topics.title: Hurricane relief pre-positioning
topics.problem: Every 12 hours before landfall, decide how much relief to produce at each distribution center, how much to ship to each shelter and whether to activate contingency capacity, under a Markov-chain forecast of hurricane track and intensity, to minimize logistics cost plus unmet-demand penalties within capacity limits.
topics.hook: Supplies must be produced and moved while landfall is still a moving forecast. The appendix lists the full South Carolina case: seven distribution centers, seven county shelters, 12-hour stages to landfall at period 11, and the cost parameters.
topics.start: [Castro, Bodur & Song, Markov chain-based policies for multistage stochastic integer programs with disaster relief, MSOM](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/fpi/10.1287/msom.2023.0658); [arXiv version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.14779); [online appendix with the synthetic generator and the Hurricane Florence / South Carolina instance](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/suppl/10.1287/msom.2023.0658/suppl_file/msom.2023.0658.sm1.pdf); [NHC forecast verification and error database](https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/verification/); model rebuilt from the paper
topics.baseline: static two-stage plan or rolling two-stage re-solve, with the paper's linear decision rule as the strong baseline
topics.angle: MPC with a hurricane-state model fitted to NHC forecast errors; amortize the multistage solve into a neural policy and compare to the linear decision rule

topics.title: Elective surgery booking with ward beds
topics.problem: Each day, decide how many waiting elective patients of each specialty to book into future OR days of a master surgical schedule, under random referrals, surgery durations and post-operative lengths of stay, to minimize waits beyond target, OR overtime and ward overcapacity.
topics.hook: Booking a surgery commits OR time on one day and a ward bed for the days after, so wait time, overtime and ward congestion trade off. The Zenodo file gives fitted duration distributions from 2,035,126 surgeries at 212 German hospitals to drive the simulator.
topics.start: [Astaraky & Patrick 2015, simulation-based ADP for multi-class, multi-resource surgical scheduling, EJOR](https://ideas.repec.org/a/eee/ejores/v245y2015i1p309-319.html); [Astaraky thesis, uOttawa](https://ruor.uottawa.ca/items/449f9534-f933-4c5a-a698-6459c0265f0c); [German surgical case mix and duration distributions (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0)](https://zenodo.org/record/7147921); [Leeftink & Hans OR scheduling benchmark and instance generator](https://www.utwente.nl/en/choir/research/benchmark-orscheduling/); model rebuilt from the paper
topics.baseline: first-come first-served booking into the earliest day with free OR time
topics.angle: least-squares approximate policy iteration as in the paper versus PPO, with a sampled-scenario MPC lookahead as a strong baseline

topics.title: Walleye fishery harvest rules
topics.problem: Harvest control rules for an age-structured, partially observed walleye fishery
topics.hook: Harvest rules decide whether a fishery survives. The population is age-structured and seen only through noisy surveys.
topics.start: [Montealegre-Mora et al. 2024, ML for harvest control rule design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.12400); [rl4fisheries](https://github.com/boettiger-lab/rl4fisheries)
topics.baseline: Constant escapement and precautionary rules
topics.angle: belief-state MPC, or a parametric rule tuned on closed-loop performance, vs RL

topics.title: Fishery near a tipping point
topics.problem: Fishery near an ecological tipping point: approximate model vs approximate solution
topics.hook: Is it better to solve a wrong model exactly, or the right model approximately? A clean experiment on this course's central question.
topics.start: [Montealegre-Mora et al. 2023, pretty darn good control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.13654); [gym_fishing](https://github.com/boettiger-lab/gym_fishing)
topics.baseline: DP on a simplified model vs a learned policy on the full one vs learned dynamics + MPC
topics.angle: the model-bias question in miniature

topics.title: Wildfire firebreaks
topics.problem: Firebreak placement or suppression dispatch on a fire-spread simulator
topics.hook: Fire seasons are getting longer as the climate warms. Placing firebreaks under uncertain weather is planning with a huge action space.
topics.start: [Murray et al. 2024, DRL for firebreak placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08523); [Cell2Fire](https://github.com/cell2fire/Cell2Fire)
topics.baseline: OR heuristics
topics.angle: amortize MILP solutions into a policy, or plan with a learned surrogate of the simulator

topics.title: Invasive species in a river network
topics.problem: Invasive species control in a river network (tamarisk)
topics.hook: Tamarisk spreads downstream along rivers. Small networks admit exact DP, so you can see exactly where approximation starts to hurt.
topics.start: [Alkaee Taleghan et al. 2015, PAC optimal MDP planning, JMLR](https://jmlr.org/papers/v16/taleghan15a.html); model in [Hall et al. 2012](https://www.cs.ubc.ca/~crowley/papers/compsust2012.pdf)
topics.baseline: Exact value iteration on small networks, greedy heuristics
topics.angle: factored MDP with combinatorial actions and simulator-based planning beyond DP

topics.title: Vaccine allocation
topics.problem: Age-structured vaccine allocation under limited supply
topics.hook: Who gets scarce doses first, and how should the plan change as case counts come in? Closed-loop allocation against open-loop plans.
topics.start: [Tonkens et al. 2021, vaccine allocation as optimal control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.11908); [Covasim](https://github.com/institutefordiseasemodeling/covasim) ([Kerr et al. 2021](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1009149))
topics.baseline: Oldest-first and the open-loop plan
topics.angle: MPC re-solved weekly from noisy case counts, robustness to model mismatch

topics.title: Mosquito releases against dengue
topics.problem: Wolbachia mosquito release schedules for dengue suppression
topics.hook: Mosquitoes carrying Wolbachia stop dengue from spreading. The release schedules come from optimal control; feedback is the missing piece.
topics.start: [Almeida et al. 2019](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.02727); [Corum et al. 2026](https://www.arxiv.org/abs/2601.10967); seasonality from [OpenDengue](https://opendengue.org/)
topics.baseline: Open-loop optimal control from the papers
topics.angle: closed-loop MPC under stochastic releases and parameter uncertainty

topics.title: Reservoir operation from US records
topics.problem: Multi-objective reservoir operation from historical records (hydropower, irrigation, flood)
topics.hook: Daily storage, inflow and release records for 679 US dams. Learn what operators do, then try to do better.
topics.start: [Wang et al. 2020, reservoir management with deep RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.03822); [Xu et al. 2021, ASCE](https://ore.exeter.ac.uk/repository/handle/10871/124834); [ResOpsUS](https://zenodo.org/records/5893641) records for 679 US dams; [pywr](https://github.com/pywr/pywr)
topics.baseline: Stochastic DP on a discretized inflow model and the historical operator policy
topics.angle: learned inflow model, scenario-tree MPC, operator imitation then offline improvement

topics.title: Optimal order execution
topics.problem: Optimal order execution in a limit order book
topics.hook: Sell a large position without moving the price against you. Almgren-Chriss is an LQ problem from this course.
topics.start: [Nevmyvaka et al. 2006, ICML](https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~mkearns/papers/rlexec); [mbt_gym](https://github.com/JJJerome/mbt_gym) ([Jerome et al. 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.07823)); [ABIDES](https://github.com/jpmorganchase/abides-jpmc-public)
topics.baseline: Almgren-Chriss (an LQ problem) and TWAP/VWAP
topics.angle: learned impact dynamics + MPC, or train in mbt_gym and test on ABIDES

topics.title: Market making
topics.problem: Market making with inventory risk
topics.hook: Quote both sides, earn the spread, and don't get stuck holding inventory. The HJB solution gives you the baseline.
topics.start: [Ganesh et al. 2019, market making in a multi-agent dealer market](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.05892); mbt_gym and ABIDES
topics.baseline: Avellaneda-Stoikov quotes from the HJB equation
topics.angle: learned fill-probability dynamics, risk-sensitive objectives, misspecification

topics.title: Monetary policy as control
topics.problem: Monetary policy as control: setting the policy rate under uncertainty
topics.hook: A central bank sets one number to steer inflation and employment. LQG with a zero lower bound, on real FRED data.
topics.start: [Wang 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17929); [Chen et al. 2021, Bank of England](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.09368); [FRED data](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/)
topics.baseline: Taylor rule and LQG on an estimated VAR
topics.angle: MPC with the zero lower bound, robustness to parameter drift

topics.title: Airline revenue management
topics.problem: Airline seat inventory control and overbooking
topics.hook: Every seat is perishable inventory with a deadline. Exact DP on one flight, approximate DP on a network.
topics.start: [Shihab et al. 2019, autonomous airline revenue management](https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.06824); [OR-Gym](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.06319)
topics.baseline: EMSR-b and exact single-leg DP
topics.angle: network revenue management with large action spaces via ADP or an amortized policy

topics.title: Ride-hailing fleet rebalancing
topics.problem: Ride-hailing fleet rebalancing on NYC taxi demand
topics.hook: Empty cars cruising for riders cost money and emissions. Real NYC demand and a fluid model make it concrete.
topics.start: [Gammelli et al. 2021, GNN RL for mobility on demand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.11434); [Feng et al. 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.14679); [NYC TLC trip records](https://www.nyc.gov/site/tlc/about/tlc-trip-record-data.page); [AMoD simulator](https://github.com/DanieleGammelli/gnn-rl-for-amod) (CPLEX academic licence)
topics.baseline: MPC with a perfect forecast as upper bound, myopic matching
topics.angle: learned demand model + MPC, or a policy that sets the parameters of a downstream LP

topics.title: Solar and battery market bidding
topics.problem: Solar plus battery bidding in energy and reserve markets
topics.hook: Batteries next to solar farms earn from energy and reserve markets at once. Real Australian market data, real price spikes.
topics.start: [Li et al. 2024, storage bidding in energy and reserve markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.19110); [Li et al. 2024, solar-storage in real-time markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15853); [AEMO NEM data](https://aemo.com.au/energy-systems/electricity/national-electricity-market-nem/data-nem/aggregated-data)
topics.baseline: Rolling-horizon MILP with a price forecast, SDP
topics.angle: joint energy and reserve co-optimization with learned price dynamics

topics.title: Data-centre cooling
topics.problem: Data-centre cooling and carbon-aware workload shifting
topics.hook: Google showed that a learned linear model plus MPC can cool a real data centre. Add carbon-aware workload shifting.
topics.start: [Lazic et al. 2018, data center cooling using MPC, NeurIPS](https://research.google/pubs/data-center-cooling-using-model-predictive-control/); [SustainDC benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.07841) and [dc-rl](https://github.com/HewlettPackard/dc-rl)
topics.baseline: Fixed setpoints, then linear MPC with a learned model as in Lazic
topics.angle: compare to the shipped multi-agent RL baselines

topics.title: LLM inference scheduling
topics.problem: LLM inference scheduling and batching under latency SLOs
topics.hook: Every chatbot answer goes through a scheduler that batches requests under latency targets. Queueing control at the heart of AI's energy bill.
topics.start: [Sarathi-Serve, Agrawal et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.02310); [Fu et al. 2024, scheduling by learning to rank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.15792); [Vidur simulator](https://github.com/microsoft/vidur); [Azure LLM traces](https://github.com/Azure/AzurePublicDataset), [BurstGPT](https://github.com/hpmll/burstgpt)
topics.baseline: FCFS and fixed chunking
topics.angle: queueing MDP with a learned output-length model, tail latency as a chance constraint

topics.title: GPU power control
topics.problem: GPU frequency and power-cap control for energy-efficient serving or training
topics.hook: Lowering a GPU's clock or power cap often costs little speed and saves a lot of energy. Find the sweet spot as the load changes.
topics.start: [DynamoLLM, Stojkovic et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.00741); [Zeus, You et al. 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.06102); [Perseus, Chung et al. 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.06902); [Zeus library](https://github.com/ml-energy/zeus)
topics.baseline: Max frequency and a static per-job optimum
topics.angle: identify frequency-to-latency and power curves, MPC over a load forecast vs an online bandit (needs a GPU you can set power limits on)

topics.title: Internet congestion control
topics.problem: Internet congestion control
topics.hook: Every TCP connection runs a controller on its sending rate. A learned controller must cope with links it has never seen.
topics.start: [Aurora, Jay et al. 2019, ICML](https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.03259); [PCC-RL](https://github.com/PCCproject/PCC-RL); [ns3-gym](https://github.com/tkn-tub/ns3-gym)
topics.baseline: CUBIC, BBR, PCC-Vivace
topics.angle: learned link model + MPC on the sending rate; generalization to unseen links

topics.title: Database tuning
topics.problem: Database knob tuning and query-optimizer steering
topics.hook: Databases have hundreds of knobs and workloads that drift. Treat tuning as control over time, not a one-shot search.
topics.start: [QTune, Li et al. 2019, PVLDB](https://www.vldb.org/pvldb/vol12/p2118-li.pdf); [Bao, Marcus et al. 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.03814); [Park](https://github.com/park-project/park) environments
topics.baseline: Defaults, Bayesian optimization, Bao's bandit
topics.angle: tuning as an MDP with workload drift and a learned performance surrogate

topics.title: Cluster job scheduling
topics.problem: DAG job scheduling on a Spark-like cluster
topics.hook: Decima learned to schedule Spark jobs with a graph policy. Real Google cluster traces let you test it under realistic load.
topics.start: [Decima, Mao et al. 2019, SIGCOMM](https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.01963); [decima-sim](https://github.com/hongzimao/decima-sim); [Google 2019 cluster trace](https://github.com/google/cluster-data/blob/master/ClusterData2019.md)
topics.baseline: FIFO, fair, shortest-job-first, critical path
topics.angle: planning with a learned stage-duration model over structured actions

topics.title: Autoscaling inference servers
topics.problem: Kubernetes autoscaling for inference pods with cold starts
topics.hook: A new GPU server takes time to start, so the autoscaler must act before the burst arrives. Delayed actions on real traces.
topics.start: [KIS-S, Zhang et al. 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.07932); [Azure Functions traces](https://github.com/Azure/AzurePublicDataset)
topics.baseline: Threshold autoscaler and M/M/c sizing
topics.angle: learned arrival and latency dynamics, MPC with a forecast; cold start makes it a delayed-action problem
